note: Per decade: n_songs = songs in the decade (scope). songs[k] = songs with that property; mentions[k] = words counted or lines flagged; max_in_one_song[k]; '<k>.songs_with' in songs = songs with at least one. Violence detail covers songs with violence threatened or enacted; weapon and violence words count only there. Sex detail covers explicit and graphic songs; crude words count only in graphic songs and are reported as groups, never as words. sex.lines / violence.lines are the lines the reader flagged as evidence (a floor, not an exhaustive count). hookup/cheating sections come from each song's topic_index.
source: card v3 (live/reads/full-v3/cards.csv), topics card t1.2 (live/reads/topics-t1/), and gated word counts over the hash-locked lyric bodies
